hero.headline:
Growing into the
fullness of Christ
hero.scripture: "Until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God and become mature, attaining to the whole measure of the fullness of Christ."

about.label: Our Vision
about.title:
A community pursuing
spiritual maturity together
body: The Maturity Project is a fellowship of 40 believers committed to growing deeper in the Word of God. We believe that spiritual maturity isn't a destination — it's a journey we walk together, season by season, study by study.
Through structured Bible study, Godly commissions, and mutual accountability, we're becoming who God created us to be.

stages.title: Foundation
stages.description: Rooted in the Word. Building the habits of daily study, prayer, and fellowship.

stages.title: Formation
stages.description: Shaped by truth. Developing understanding and letting Scripture transform the mind.

stages.title: Commission
stages.description: Sent with purpose. Discovering and walking in your God-given assignment.

stages.title: Multiplication
stages.description: Bearing fruit. Pouring into others and extending the Kingdom through service.

commissions.label: Godly Commissions
commissions.title: Called to Serve
commissions.body: Each commission is an extension of our purpose — equipping members to serve the body and the world with their unique gifts.

cards.title: Prayer & Intercession
cards.description: Standing in the gap for the fellowship, our families, and our communities through consistent, fervent prayer.

cards.title: Teaching & Discipleship
cards.description: Facilitating Bible studies, mentoring new believers, and ensuring sound doctrine flows through the fellowship.

cards.title: Outreach & Evangelism
cards.description: Extending the love of Christ beyond our walls — community service, campus ministry, and missions.

cards.title: Worship & Creative Arts
cards.description: Leading the fellowship into God's presence through music, spoken word, and creative expression.

cards.title: Welfare & Care
cards.description: Meeting practical needs, checking on members, and creating a culture of genuine love and support.

cards.title: Administration & Media
cards.description: Keeping the fellowship organized, managing communications, and documenting our journey.

schedule.label: Study Calendar
schedule.title:
Upcoming
Sessions
schedule.body: We gather weekly for Bible study and monthly for fellowship. All sessions are open to committed members.

connect.label: Join Us
connect.title:
Begin Your Journey
Toward Maturity
connect.body: Whether you're new to faith or have walked with Christ for years, there's a place for you here. Come grow with us.

footer.scripture: "He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion."
